verdict.rationale: Vestd has a dedicated HRIS Integration page saying you can "Connect your HR platform to Vestd and end the manual data shuffle," so a first-party HR integration exists. The evidence is only a one-line marketing claim, though. It gives no detail on what syncs or how the sync behaves. Missing for 10: named supported HRIS/payroll providers (e.g. Gusto, Rippling), evidence that new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically, sync direction/frequency documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
